name: io.github.xiaobinger/oss-mcp-server
title: Aliyun OSS MCP Server
description: Aliyun OSS file tools for MCP: upload, replace, download, zip, delete, signed URLs.

environmentVariables.name: OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Aliyun AccessKey ID with access to the target OSS bucket.

environmentVariables.name: OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Aliyun AccessKey Secret paired with OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

environmentVariables.name: OSS_SECURITY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional STS security token for temporary credentials.

environmentVariables.name: OSS_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Optional custom domain used for public-read object URLs.

environmentVariables.name: OSS_DEFAULT_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Optional default object key prefix added to relative paths.

environmentVariables.name: OSS_PUBLIC_READ
environmentVariables.description: Whether the bucket is public-read; true or false.
